articles.summary: Corning Incorporated (NYSE: GLW) today announced third-quarter 2026 results that exceeded guidance and provided its outlook for fourth-quarter 2026. News Summary: Corning grew third-quarter core sales 19% year over year to $5.08 billion – the strongest growth since the launch of Springboard – and grew core EPS nearly twice as fast to $0.91. articles.summary: Corning Incorporated’s (NYSE: GLW) Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend on October 6, 2026 of $0.28 per share. The dividend will be payable on December 11, 2026, to shareholders of record on November 13, 2026.
